name: segno
description: Segno: study Synthesia-style piano videos (player, navigation, transcription, harmony).

scripts.check: pnpm check:ui && pnpm check:rust && pnpm check:engine
scripts.check:ui: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm --filter @segno/ui build
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace --locked
scripts.check:engine: uv run --directory engine ruff check . && uv run --directory engine ruff format --check . && uv run --directory engine pyright && uv run --directory engine pytest
